text: 史 笑 理 员 : Teksid config -Ial , [ 1. To collect unreferenced folders: collect_garbage -folder 2. To collect unreferenced folders and items: collect_garbage -folder -item 3. To collect unreferenced folders and items and get a report to stdout: collect_garbage -folder -item -report 4. To collect all unreferenced objects except orphans: collect_garbage -all 5. To delete folders collected in the WASTE BASKET: collect_garbage -folder -delete 6. To delete all objects collected in the WASTE BASKET except orphans: collect_garbage -all -delete 7. To collect all item revisions with no parent item: collect_garbage -orphan 8. To delete orphan item reuisions in the WASTE BASKET: collect_garbage -orphan -delete 9. To collect unreferenced items into file item_rep: collect_garbage -item -query -rf:item_rep 10.To process the aboue items and insert into folder: collect_garbage -item -report -if=item_rep 11.To delete items in the SUB WASTE BASKET: collect_garbage -item -delete -sub_folder=WBITEM_item_rep 12.To collect unreferenced forms when there are too many forms in th database to load in memory: W UGITC
